label: rem:isospin-selection-class-inhabited
title: $\mathrm{InterfaceExchangeAntisymmetry}$ is inhabited by $\langle\mathrm{select},\,\mathrm{rfl}\rangle$ --- the class carries physics, not a constraint
html:
Remark. \mathrm{InterfaceExchangeAntisymmetry} is inhabited by \langle\mathrm{select},\,\mathrm{rfl}\rangle --- the class carries physics, not a constraint

The selection rule is carried by a conjecture class with two fields: a coupling assigning a colour system to each nucleon-pair channel, and the constraint that the coupling equals \mathrm{select}. Stated that way the class is inhabited by construction. Taking the coupling to be \mathrm{select} itself and the constraint to be reflexivity exhibits a witness, so the class constrains nothing as a mathematical object.

The opposite was previously asserted. A class whose only field is pinned to a definition already in scope cannot fail to be satisfiable, and an argument that leaned on its non-vacuity would be leaning on nothing.

What remains open, and why it is not vacuity

The class does not assert that some coupling satisfies the rule. It asserts that the coupling induced by the physical interface is \mathrm{select}. No formal inhabitation can establish that, and none is claimed: what the witness shows is that the mathematical content of the class is empty, leaving its physical content intact and entirely unproved. The four consequences drawn from it therefore stay conditional --- charge symmetry between pp and nn, the forcing of the like-nucleon channels onto T_1, the freeing of the deuteron channel alone, and the grouping of the symmetric pn state with the like-nucleon pairs --- but the hypothesis they wait on is a physical identification, not an open theorem.

Inhabitation is recorded as a statement about non-emptiness and deliberately not as a typeclass instance. Registering an instance would let resolution discharge the hypothesis automatically, silently converting all four conditional theorems into unconditional statements about \mathrm{select}. Those statements would be true, they would follow by evaluating a two-line table, and they would be worthless --- while reading, to anyone scanning the file, as though the physics had been proved. Keeping the fact as a non-emptiness statement records it without changing what anything downstream depends on.
